title: National ID services
guidance: The Bangladesh Election Commission's NID Wing lists online NID services, smart card status, amendments, and duplicate NID information. Open the official site for the current service instructions.
notes: General service pointer only; does not state requirements or fees.

title: Birth registration services
guidance: Use BDRIS for registration, correction, application tracking, certificate reprinting and record verification.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: E-passport services
guidance: The official e-Passport portal offers online applications and re-issues, application instructions, and a link to current fees. Check it before applying.

title: Online tax services
guidance: The National Board of Revenue e-Tax portal links to e-TIN registration, e-Return filing, return verification, and tax payment services.

title: Online general diary
guidance: Use Online GD for complaints and follow-up. Do not wait for online processing in an emergency.

title: Driving licence services
guidance: The BRTA Service Portal supports learner licences, driving licences, renewals, and duplicate licences. Register or sign in there for current service options.

title: Birth registration application
guidance: Choose the registration office, then enter personal, parent and address information in BDRIS. Review the form before submitting.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Learner driving licence
guidance: A learner licence precedes the driving licence. Start through BSP and check current eligibility and documents.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, application process

title: Apply for a duplicate NID
guidance: Sign in to NID services and choose the duplicate/reissue application for a lost or damaged card. Follow the displayed requirements.

title: Apply for birth registration online
guidance: Complete the BDRIS form, supply the requested evidence and verify the contact channel before submitting. Submission is an application, not an issued certificate.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Apply for an e-passport online
guidance: The e-Passport portal provides an online application for a new passport or re-issue. Read its instructions and check regional availability before starting.
notes: Application requirements vary; use the official instructions.

title: File a tax return online
guidance: Sign in to e-Return, open Return submission, complete the relevant sections, review the return and submit. Keep the acknowledgement.
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ
notes: Workflow only; no current-year filing obligation or deadline asserted.

title: Submit an online GD
guidance: Sign in, select the complaint and police station, enter incident time, location and details, attach relevant evidence and submit.

title: Apply for a learner licence
guidance: Create a BSP account with your NID, complete the profile and learner application, upload evidence and pay the displayed fee.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, application process

title: Start a new NID application
guidance: Use the new-registration option only if not already registered. Complete and review the form, then print it for submission with supporting papers to the election office.

title: Register an NID services account
guidance: Already have an NID? Choose Register on the official portal. New voter enrolment is a separate application, not account registration.

title: Sign in to NID services
guidance: Enter your NID number or username, password and displayed security code on the official login page. Never share your password here.

title: Reset an NID account password
guidance: Select the forgotten-password link on the NID portal and follow its identity checks. Do not send passwords or verification codes to this app.

title: Download an NID copy
guidance: If already registered but awaiting a card copy, register an online account and use its download option. This is not new voter enrolment.

title: Calculate an NID service fee
guidance: Use the official fee calculator with your NID, application type, delivery type and security code. Check the calculated charge for your own request before paying.
official_source: Bangladesh Election Commission, NID fee calculator

title: Correct NID information
guidance: Apply through NID services or the election office with evidence supporting the requested change. Requirements depend on the field being corrected.

title: Correct an NID date of birth
guidance: Submit evidence of the correct birth date. SSC-qualified applicants use their SSC/equivalent certificate; other applicants must follow the FAQ's employment and alternative-evidence conditions.
required_documents: SSC/equivalent certificate if applicable; otherwise evidence specified for your category
notes: Category-specific evidence, not a universal checklist.

title: Correct an NID address
guidance: Submit an address correction with attested evidence of the correct address. Changing voter area is a separate request.
required_documents: Applicable deed, utility bill, rental agreement or rent receipt

title: Correct an NID blood group
guidance: For adding or correcting blood group, submit a medical certificate supporting the change with the NID correction request.

title: Choose a birth registration office
guidance: BDRIS offers birthplace, permanent-address or Bangladesh-embassy registration. Select the appropriate location and office before entering the application.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Review before birth registration submission
guidance: Check every field with the applicant before submitting. BDRIS warns that the submitted application cannot subsequently be edited in that form.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Verify birth registration contact details
guidance: Enter the OTP on BDRIS only. The form uses mobile verification for Bangladesh applications and email for Bangladesh missions abroad.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Birth record correction
guidance: Use BDRIS correction for an existing record. Parent-name changes have separate mapping rules; consult those instructions before submitting.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Apply to correct a birth record
guidance: Find your record using birth registration number and birth date, select the correction and give its reason. A linked mobile number, or email for missions, is required; contact the office if missing.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Link a parent's corrected birth record
guidance: If a parent has a birth registration number, correct their own record first. If not linked to yours, arrange the BRN mapping; then reprint your certificate. For parents without BRNs, follow the separate date-of-birth and death-evidence rules on the source page.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Verify a birth registration record
guidance: On the official verification page, enter the 17-digit birth registration number, birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format and the displayed challenge answer. Enter these details there, not in this chat.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Check a birth registration application
guidance: Choose birth-registration application status from BDRIS and enter the details requested there. Application tracking and verification of an issued certificate are different services.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Print a birth registration application
guidance: Choose birth-registration application print from the BDRIS menu. This prints the application, not an approved birth certificate.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Request a birth certificate reprint
guidance: Use the birth-certificate reprint option in BDRIS. Do not use application print when you need the issued certificate.
official_source: Office of the Registrar General, Birth and Death Registration

title: Choose a passport office
guidance: In onboarding, select whether you are applying from Bangladesh. For domestic applications, enter your present-address district and nearest police station to see the assigned regional office.

title: Enter passport identity information
guidance: Complete the application according to your NID or online English birth registration certificate. For an under-18 applicant without an NID, include a parent's NID number.

title: Passport enrolment documents
guidance: Prepare the official enrolment checklist. The papers needed vary with identity evidence, previous passports, government employment and requested corrections.

title: Prepare passport enrolment papers
guidance: Bring the applicable documents below to enrolment. Additional evidence may be required for your application category or corrections; this is not a universal eligibility decision.
required_documents: Printed application form and summary, including appointment if any
Original NID or birth certificate, as applicable
GO/NOC for government employment, as applicable
Evidence for requested corrections, if any

title: Prepare a child's passport application
guidance: An under-18 applicant without an NID must provide a parent's NID number. Use online English birth registration evidence; children under six also need the specified 3R photograph. Check the complete official instructions.
required_documents: For under-six applicants: 3R lab-printed photograph with grey background

title: Bring the previous passport
guidance: For reissue, present the original previous passport. If it is lost, follow the lost-passport procedure instead.

title: Report and replace a lost passport
guidance: Report the loss promptly to the nearest police station. For the replacement application, submit the GD copy and a photocopy of the old passport with the application; present the original GD copy.

title: Track a passport application
guidance: Use Status Check with your application ID or online registration ID and birth date. The application ID is on the enrolment delivery slip; signed-in accounts also show application status.

title: Check the applicable passport fee
guidance: Consult the official fee table for the application location, page count, validity and delivery category. Domestic and mission fees differ; confirm available options before payment.

title: Find a passport payment receipt
guidance: Open the official fees page and follow the receipt link matching the payment channel used. Keep the receipt, particularly for offline-payment enrolment.

title: Sign in to the passport portal
guidance: Sign in with your registered email and password and complete the security challenge. Use Forgot Password on that page if necessary; keep credentials private.

title: Register for e-Return
guidance: Register using your TIN and a mobile number biometrically registered with your NID. Verify the OTP and set a password.
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ

title: Sign in to e-Return
guidance: After registration, sign in using your TIN and password. Enter credentials only on the official e-Return portal.
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ

title: Prepare records for e-Return
guidance: Keep supporting records ready for accurate entry. Follow the current assessment year's upload requirements, not a previous year's exemption.
required_documents: Applicable income, investment, expenditure, asset/liability and tax-payment records
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ
notes: Supporting records are not a universal upload checklist.

title: Download return acknowledgement
guidance: After online submission, use Tax record to print the acknowledgement slip as proof of submission.
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ

title: Download a filed tax return
guidance: Use Tax record to print the submitted return. A saved draft is not proof of filing.
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ

title: Get an income-tax certificate
guidance: After submitting through e-Return, access the available tax certificate from Tax record.
official_source: National Board of Revenue e-service FAQ

title: Get official e-Return support
guidance: Open the e-Tax portal's e-Return support service for assistance. Avoid sending passwords or OTPs with your request.

title: Register for Online GD
guidance: Register with NID, current address, live photo and active mobile; set a password and verify the SMS code.

title: Prepare Online GD identity details
guidance: Online GD requires NID information, an active mobile and a live photo. Provide these only on the official portal.

title: When a complaint requires station attendance
guidance: Police determine the complaint type. For a cognizable offence, attend the station with the complaint printout or reference code.

title: Track an Online GD complaint
guidance: Sign in after submission to see complaint progress and the investigating officer's details, when assigned.

title: Attach complaint evidence
guidance: Add relevant supporting documents while entering complaint details. Check the form before submission.

title: Download a digital GD copy
guidance: For a complaint accepted as a GD, obtain its digital copy through Online GD. Submission alone does not guarantee acceptance.

title: Get urgent police assistance
guidance: For an emergency in Bangladesh, call the national emergency service 999. Do not wait for an online GD response. This app cannot dispatch help.
notes: Emergency contact, not automated dispatch or incident classification.

title: Check learner licence eligibility
guidance: BRTA lists class-eight education and physical/mental fitness. Minimum age is 18 for non-professional and 21 for professional licensing. Check the current rules for your category.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, application process

title: Prepare learner licence documents
guidance: Upload the applicable evidence below. A current-address utility bill is needed when that address differs from your NID; follow BSP's current file limits.
required_documents: Medical certificate from a registered doctor
Current-address utility bill if different from NID
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, application process

title: Get the driving licence medical form
guidance: BRTA lists Form 2 for the driving-licence medical certificate. Use the official form and arrange completion by a registered doctor as required by the application instructions.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, driving licence forms
notes: Form source; fitness assessment belongs to the doctor.

title: Prepare for the driving test
guidance: Attend on the assigned date with the learner licence and instructed papers. BRTA requires in-person biometrics and identity verification.
required_documents: Other papers specified for your test
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, application process

title: Check driving test results
guidance: Use Driving Exam (DCTC) Result on BSP to find the published result for your division and district.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, Service Portal

title: Check a driving licence fee
guidance: Use BSP's Fee Calculator for your service. Confirm the category and applicable charges before payment; a historical fee table may differ.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, Service Portal

title: Verify a BRTA payment
guidance: Follow Payment Verification from the official BSP homepage and use the transaction details requested there. Keep your payment receipt.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, Service Portal

title: Verify a driving licence
guidance: Choose Driving License Verification from BSP. Use the licence details requested by that official service; verification does not renew a licence.
official_source: Bangladesh Road Transport Authority, Service Portal
